Root cause: option declarations were stored in the parser using their original casing, while command-line tokens were normalized before lookup.

Updated `OptionParser.add_option` to normalize short and long option names when registering them. This makes declarations such as `--Greeting`, `--Name`, and `-N` match any casing when token normalization is enabled, including normalized flag alternatives.
